assembly.stem: A regional health authority plans to invite 60 000 adults a year to a new screening test, and expects about 3000 positive results a year. One regional centre performs the confirmatory procedure for the whole region; it completes about 900 procedures a year and its current wait is 14 weeks. The regional treatment service can accept about 120 new patients a year, against roughly 200 who would be expected to need treatment. Invitations are scheduled to be mailed in the spring.
